articles.title: St. Vincent de Paul
articles.introtext:
Assistance Hotline

All assistance requests must go through their hotline - (815) 334-7711. Please leave a voicemail and one of the SVDP members will return your call within 24 hours.

ABOUT SVDP

Founded in 1833, the Society of St. Vincent de Paul is a worldwide organization of lay Catholics, following Christ’s call to serve the poor, the suffering, and the deprived.

Our founding activity, still practiced today, is the Home Visit. Through these visits, Vincentian members establish personal relationships with our neighbors in need, not only providing material assistance such as rent, utilities, food, or clothing, but also offering friendship, understanding, and prayer.

The National Council of the United States was established to support local St. Vincent de Paul Conferences and Councils, and to represent them among the global Society’s membership. Today, the National Council provides resources, training, and spiritual formation for nearly 100,000 Vincentians in 5,000 Conferences and Councils across the country.

Because “no work of charity is foreign to the Society,” Vincentians respond to many community and individual needs through programs such as disaster relief services, job training and placement, thrift stores, food pantries, housing programs, prison reentry, medical services, and many others, always seeking longer-term pathways out of poverty and towards the full flourishing of every person.

The St. Vincent de Paul Society is a worldwide organization of Catholic men and women volunteering to help those in need – spiritually, economically, and emotionally.

 The St. Mary Conference has been helping people in the Woodstock area since 2003. 

meeting information

First and Third Tuesday of the month at 6:30pm in St. Joseph Center Basement.  

St. Vincent de Paul relies solely upon your generosity to help serve those who are financially struggling. If you would like to make a tax-deductible donation you may do so through the parish collection, by stopping by the parish office or electronically below.

Donate today!

Click the link below to donate! When you arrive at the donation page, click the drop-down fund menu and select "St. Vincent de Paul Society".

Click Here to Donate Online

 

Share the bounty program

Every Summer, St. Vincent de Paul offers a produce-sharing program called Share the Bounty. We ask local gardeners to contribute some of their extra harvests to a community table, located in the St. Joseph Center. The produce there is available to parishioners for donation. All donations support the St. Vincent de Paul outreach ministry. Any leftover produce is donated to local food pantries.

st. Vincent de Paul car donation program

Do you have an old car that you would like to donate to the St. Vincent de Paul Society?  Your donation will not only provide you with a tax deduction, but it will also provide valuable funds to our society so that we can continue assisting those who are in need.

articles.title: Religious Education & Formation
articles.introtext:
The Gospel tells us that we are called to know the Truth and that "the Truth will set us free!"  At St. Mary we strive to be a beacon of that truth for all ages.

St. Mary Catholic School strives to educate our children in the Gospel by incorporating it into all aspects of their daily life.

For those who do not attend St. Mary Catholic School, the Religious Education Program at St. Mary's serves children grades preschool-12.

For all middle school - high school students, St. Mary strives to offer youth ministry opportunities throughout the year.

Perhaps you are an adult and are not Catholic.  If you would like to learn more about the Catholic Church, even if you are not yet ready to become Catholic, then we offer a variety of opportunities.  See our R.C.I.A. (Rite of Christian Initiation for Adults) page for more information.

Ongoing adult education opportunities are an essential part of every Catholic's journey.  St. Mary offers a variety or educational Bible studies, teachings, adult classes, and more.

Perhaps you are gifted with a deep and rich understanding of the Catholic faith and would like to share that faith with others.  Please contact us and let us know how you would like to get involved.
